data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek 'Lianos', meaning 'God's grace' or 'God's gift'. In Christian tradition, it symbolizes the heavenly gift bestowed upon the child, representing a connection to the divine. The name Lianne carries the meaning “God's grace, heavenly gift” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Lianne usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace, heavenly gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
